dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: The master I just referred to?

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: A lot of our business is left up to him, including our most important silk trade.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: As incredibly gifted as he may be in the art of business, his heart isn't in it. He has a habit of suddenly disappearing.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: What's even more impressive is the fact that this hasn't affected business in the slightest. Conversely, business over the last few years has only become better and better.

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: Even if you do manage to catch him, there's nothing to really accost him for anyway so...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't make sense of it...
